# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- User wants code to follow guidelines: meaningful names for variables, functions, classes, etc.; consistent naming/formatting; self-documenting code; consistent formatting; only one indentation level; avoid else; encapsulate primitives with behavior; appropriate class/method length; single-responsibility principle; and meaningful comments.
- Apply the single-responsibility principle when possible.
- Remove all comments unless necessary for complex parts; user will add comments manually if needed.

## Array Operations
- Arrays must be strictly typed; default values are 0 for double arrays, false for bool arrays, and empty strings for string arrays.
- Sort applies to all arrays.
- Array operations use a new Array Operator block.
